scope: EG differentiable decoding zero-update check only
forward_panel: Existing 48 C3 frames, all 49152 cached raw candidates
gradient_panel: Frame 0 of each of the same 12 scenes; all existing final clean feasible/weak candidates; fixed before results
PCR: Official RA+RC+RS; preserve detached SDF normals; no new normal derivative
angle_surrogate: softmax weighted pi-wrapped local offsets about hard argmax; antipodal 90deg bin offset zero
direction_checks: Only ephemeral pose variables, no model weights updated; compare gradient direction with recomputed and frozen-normal PCR at +/-0.1 and +/-0.5 degree; +/-0.05 and +/-0.2 mm
unchanged_check: Adapted and original decoder same inputs/device bitwise equality; cached prediction discrepancies separately reported
caveat: Gradient connectivity and proxy descent do not establish force-closure improvement or learning benefit
